rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and ZIP, matched to a single user, and confirmed the correct order (#W9502127). After the user clearly confirmed the air purifier and the canister vacuum, the agent initiated the return via the tool, which shows status updated to return requested for the correct item IDs and the correct user and order. The refund total provided ($1,095.55) matches the item prices from the tool, and the remaining-items total ($1,528.14) was calculated correctly. The agent clearly stated the refund would go to the original PayPal method and accurately explained it cannot guarantee a 3-day refund, aligning with typical payment processing timelines. All actions were on the authenticated user’s account, no unsupported claims were made, and there were no improper writes without user confirmation of the items. Minor note: the agent did not explicitly restate “I will proceed” before the write, but the user’s explicit confirmation of the items to return fulfills the confirmation requirement. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
